title: Nourishing Roasted Canadian Chicken Skewers
description: A hearty Canadian dish featuring roasted chicken skewers marinated in a mixture of spices and birds-eye chillies, perfect for a hangover cure. This paleo-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, coconut aminos, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken skewers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, slice the birds-eye chillies into thin rounds.
After the chicken has cooked for 15 minutes, add the sliced birds-eye chillies to the baking sheet and continue roasting for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the roasted chicken skewers hot and enjoy.
